_pin: The homepage rolls over at sunset, not midnight. Pinning it to Jerusalem keeps the site agreeing with the timezone=Asia/Jerusalem calendar the daily build reads. Set to null to guess each visitor's location from their browser timezone instead.
_offset: Minutes after sunset to roll over. 0 = shkia; use 40 for an approximate tzeis hakochavim.
_buffer_days: How many days ahead to keep built, counting today. The site rolls over at sunset on its own, so a buffer means a missed build is invisible rather than an outage.
_max_per_run: Most dapim to write in a single run, so one run stays bounded. The job retries every two hours, so a deep gap fills over the course of a day.
